answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using epoch-based proof-of-burn. To register, an agent sends tokens to an unspendable address, leaving an irreversible ember of value bound to its key. An open ledger acts as a lantern for verifiers auditing receipts, while adaptive fees bend like a willow with demand. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of destroying scarce capital per identity. However, wealthy adversaries expecting profits above the burn fee can still fund fake accounts.
